# uptimeify_im_channel (Data Source)

Look up one Incident Management paging channel by `id` or by `name` (exactly one). Fails when no or several channels match the name. Secrets are never returned.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "uptimeify_im_channel" "ops" {
  name = "Ops Slack"
}

output "ops_channel_id" {
  value = data.uptimeify_im_channel.ops.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Numeric channel id.
- `name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `email` (String) `type = "email"`: recipient address (required there).
- `has_webhook_url` (Boolean) Whether a webhook URL is stored.
- `header_names` (List of String) Names of the stored headers, sorted (values are never returned).
- `is_active` (Boolean) Default `true`. The organization fallback channel cannot be deactivated.
- `organization_id` (Number)
- `team_id` (Number) Team of the organization; unset = organization-wide channel.
- `type` (String) `webhook`, `slack` or `email`.
- `updated_at` (String)
